_meta.source: Static, redacted copies of the signed-in linear.app web app (tools/capture/signed-in/snapshot.js) with every stylesheet inlined, the constructed theme sheet included, loaded from file:// in headless Chromium; fonts come from static.linear.app through a local cache. Nothing was requested from linear.app itself.
_meta.themes: Dark copies were taken with the account theme Dark, light copies with it set to Light (and set back afterwards). Dark states have plain names; light states are `light`, `light-<state>`. Every state records `theme` and `snapshot`.

states.hover: real mouse hover (page.mouse.move), 450ms settle; not measured on the 390 copies
states.focus-visible: real keyboard focus (focus, Shift+Tab, Tab) on the element or its first focusable descendant; recorded as skipped where the element cannot take focus
states.pressed: mouse hover, then the button held down for 250ms (:active)
states.other: selected / open / readonly / off / option-highlighted are other elements or copies captured in that state

_meta.tokens: `vars` lists every var(--x) named in the classes of the element and its first descendants (Linear's stylex classes name none, so this is usually empty; the theme variables are read by tools/capture/vars.mjs).
